name: EU olive oil
source_note: Representative values for an EU extra virgin olive oil, declared per 100 ml. Included as the clearest case where the declared kJ and kcal figures are not related by 4.184: 91.6 g of fat gives 3389 kJ from the Annex XIV kJ column and 824 kcal from its kcal column, a ratio of 4.112.
